criteria.rationale: The deliverable and tool trace accurately follow all operative sources and authority rules. The solver inspected the operations workspace and resolved the conflict between the $110 draft freight rate (in Shipping parameters.xlsx, working-notes.txt, and record-22.txt) and the $150 approved freight rate (in record-17.txt) by applying the operative revision 2 rate per registry.txt. All pick ticket quantities, weights, shipping method selections (UPS for 2.5 lbs, Freight for 250 lbs, Fed Ex for 50 lbs), costs ($5.95, $150, $75; total $230.95), industry averages ($7.95, $225, $79.99; total $312.94), and savings ($2.00, $75.00, $4.99; total $81.99) are arithmetically exact and consistent across all sheets. Furthermore, the solver did not invent missing tracking numbers or processing dates.
